label: biennial life span
definition: A life span quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's expected natural life span being more than one year and no more than two years.
rationale: Completes the approved annual (FLOPO:0985010, at most one year) / perennial (FLOPO:0985011, more than two years) partition of PATO:0000050 life span; PATO has no biennial value (checked ont/quality.obo). Propose to PATO with the annual/perennial batch.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: arborescent habit
definition: A morphology quality inhering in a plant by virtue of the plant having a tree-like habit, with a single dominant, self-supporting main stem that bears a crown and attains tree stature.
rationale: No PATO value for the tree habit; PATO:0095004 arboreal is a different referent (adaptation for living in trees). Resemblance sense of the approved FLOPO-CAND:arborescent_growth revision: woodiness is deliberately not part of the quality (tree ferns, palms).
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: frutescent habit
definition: A morphology quality inhering in a plant by virtue of the plant being woody and much branched, with several stems or main branches arising at or near ground level and no single dominant trunk.
rationale: No PATO value for the shrub habit. Follows the approved FLOPO-CAND:shrubby_growth definition of FLOPO:0900034.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: suffrutescent habit
definition: A morphology quality inhering in a plant by virtue of the plant being low, usually less than 1 m high, with a persistent woody base from which herbaceous or only partly woody upper shoots arise.
rationale: Subshrub habit (NCVC Q15, 7 Saudi rows). The released FLOPO:0980083 shoot axis suffruticose has a shoot-axis bearer, so it cannot carry a whole-plant habit value.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant suffrutescent
definition: A whole plant growth form phenotype in which the plant is a subshrub: low, usually less than 1 m high, with a persistent woody base from which herbaceous or only partly woody upper shoots arise.
rationale: Whole-plant counterpart of the subshrub habit; sibling of whole plant frutescent (no subclass or disjointness asserted: glossaries disagree on whether subshrubs are small shrubs).
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant lifestyle
rationale: Attribute class: a whole plant that has some life span quality. Necessary and sufficient; mirrors released attribute classes such as whole plant shedability.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: shoot axis suffruticose
rationale: Necessary only: its definition says the shoot axis is woody at the base. Not sufficient: the herbaceous upper branches are not expressible without negation.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant lianescent
rationale: Necessary only: woody climbers (approved FLOPO-CAND:liana) are perennial. Its released ligneous shoot-axis axiom is kept.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: shoot axis ligneous
rationale: Necessary and sufficient restatement of its approved definition (MAP-CAND:woody). No other FLOPO class has signature EQ|PO_0025029|PATO_0002348.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: tissue succulent
rationale: Its definition and dcterms:source already name PATO:0104019 succulent (a water-storage composition quality). No other FLOPO class has signature EQ|PO_0009007|PATO_0104019.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant therophytic
rationale: Necessary only: a therophyte completes its life cycle within one favourable season and survives only as seed.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant chamaephytic
rationale: Necessary only: chamaephyte perennating buds are borne on persistent shoots.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant phanerophytic
rationale: Necessary only: phanerophyte perennating buds are borne on persistent aerial shoots.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: annual, biennial and perennial life span
rationale: The approved numeric boundaries (at most one year; more than one and at most two years; more than two years) partition life span. Because phenotypes use has_part some (whole plant and ...), a taxon described as annual or perennial stays satisfiable.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant biennial
definition: A whole plant lifestyle phenotype in which the plant has a biennial life span, its expected natural life span from germination to death being more than one year and no more than two years; it typically grows vegetatively in the first year and flowers and fruits in the second.
rationale: Aligns the OBO QC definition (less than two years) with GF-Q01 so that text and equivalence agree.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant perennial
definition: A whole plant lifestyle phenotype in which the plant has a perennial life span, its expected natural life span being more than two years; it usually flowers and fruits repeatedly.
rationale: The OBO QC definition (life span over more than one growing season) also covers biennials and contradicts the approved perennial life span (more than two years).
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant climbing phenotype
rationale: Curator decision on FLOPO-CAND:climber (accept_with_revision 2026-09-18): keep primitive until a relation to an external support is selected.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant vine phenotype
rationale: Not woody is a negation (outside EL); PATO:0002352 herbaceous is the die-back homonym, so it must not be used.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant epiphytic
rationale: Relational (grows on another plant without parasitism). Needs RO:0008501 epiphyte of plus a host; no PATO quality fits.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant herbaceous
rationale: Already EQ: PO:0000003 + PATO:0002352 (die-back sense), in botanical extension 2.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant evergreen (plant)
rationale: Already EQ: PO:0000003 + PATO:0001733.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant deciduous
rationale: No FLOPO class exists. The pair PO_0000003 x PATO_0001731 is curator-approved (2026-09-18); the reviewed-combinations pipeline mints the EQ class. No local quality is needed.

label: whole plant succulent
rationale: No FLOPO class exists. The pair PO_0000003 x PATO_0104019 is curator-approved (2026-09-18); the reviewed-combinations pipeline mints the EQ class.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: whole plant graminoid / forbacious
rationale: Stay under whole plant herbaceous. Grass-like and forb need taxon or resemblance context (SURFACE-CAND:grass_context); no quality.
curator_notes: Approved as schema-extension item A1 by the curator on 2026-09-18.

label: Raunkiaer cryptophyte and hemicryptophyte classes
rationale: Many hemicryptophytes and some geophytes are biennial, so no life-span axiom; bud position relative to soil has no PATO quality.
